minigames.name: Spin Cycle
minigames.caption: Jump and duck as the ramp speeds up.
minigames.description: Six robots stand on a spiral ramp around a reactor. Jump the orange rods and duck under the violet ones as the ramp speeds up. Seven hits and you’re out. Last robot standing wins.
minigames.controls: `Space` or `Up` to jump over orange rods. Hold `S` or `Down` to duck under violet rods.
minigames.touchControls: tap the right side to jump and hold the left side to duck.

screenshot.alt: Colorful robots jump a sweeping bar on a circular arena.

minigames.name: Live Wire
minigames.caption: Paint the floor and dodge the surges.
minigames.description: Race to paint a hex floor in your color. Close a loop to lock in your tiles, dodge the reactor’s surges, and dash into rivals to knock them off course. Most tiles after 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to run. Press `Space` to dash and shove.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move and tap the right side to dash.

screenshot.alt: Six robots on a hex floor painted in their colors while red surge lines cross the board.

minigames.name: Bumper Cars
minigames.caption: Stay afloat as the dock shrinks.
minigames.description: Boost into rivals on a floating dock with no railings. Five rings sink one at a time, shrinking the arena. Stay out of the water and be the last car afloat.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Press `Space` to boost and move inward when the outer ring flashes.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tap the right side to boost.

screenshot.alt: Colorful bumper cars on a floating dock with its outer ring glowing before it sinks.

minigames.name: Sumo
minigames.caption: Shove rivals out of the ring to score.
minigames.description: Shove rivals out of a fixed ring to score. If you fall, you respawn quickly and can get back in the fight. The highest score after 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move. Let go to brace. Press `Space` to shove.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move, let go to brace, and tap the right side to shove.

screenshot.alt: Robots competing inside the Sumo ring and a scoreboard tracking knockouts.

minigames.name: Orb Racing
minigames.caption: Clear the checkpoints and finish three laps.
minigames.description: Race for three laps and drive through the checkpoints in order. Cross the recharge strips to refill your boost.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Press `Space` to boost.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tap the right side to boost.

screenshot.alt: Racers on the Orb Racing track with lap and position indicators.

minigames.name: Stampede Sheriff
minigames.caption: Herd critters and steal them from your rivals.
minigames.description: Walk behind wind-up critters to guide them into your pen. Clap to scatter a herd or steal it from a rival. Watch the hatches for double-value critters. Most points after 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move. Press `Space` to clap in the last direction you moved.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move and tap the right side to clap.

screenshot.alt: Robots herd wind-up critters toward colored pens as a gold critter emerges from a hatch.

minigames.name: Plate Panic
minigames.caption: Tilt the table and redirect rolling marbles.
minigames.description: Every robot’s weight tilts the same tabletop. Roll marbles into your pocket or drop a wedge to redirect a roll. The player who pockets the most marbles in 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move and tilt the table. Press `Space` to place a wedge in the last direction you moved.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move and tap the right side to place a wedge.

screenshot.alt: Robots tilt a tabletop with rolling marbles, wedges, and six colored scoring pockets.

minigames.name: Salvage Line
minigames.caption: Tow cargo home and cut rival lines.
minigames.description: Hook floating crates and tow them into your numbered harbor to deliver them. Heavy crates slow your tug but score double. Cut a rival’s exposed tow rope to send their cargo adrift. The most cargo weight delivered in 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Press `Space` to hook, cut, or release. Tap it inside your harbor to deliver your cargo.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tap the right side to use the winch.

screenshot.alt: Numbered tugboats tow floating crates across the harbor with their tow lines visible.
